repo_path.description: Absolute path to the Borg repository where backups are stored.

ssh_key_path.description: Absolute path to the SSH private key used for remote repo access. Leave empty if using local or password-based auth.

level.description: Compression level (−1 = default). Valid: zlib (0–9), zstd (0–22), lz4 (ignored, always fast).

encryption.description: Encryption mode. Use 'none' for unencrypted repos (not recommended).

mode.description: Encryption mode. 'repokey-blake2' is recommended for most use cases.

archive_name_prefix.description: Template for naming backup archives. Supports placeholders like {hostname}, {now}, {uuid}.

keep_within.description: Keep archives within this duration (e.g., '3D' = 3 days).

keep_daily.description: Number of daily archives to retain.

keep_weekly.description: Number of weekly archives to retain.

keep_monthly.description: Number of monthly archives to retain.

keep_yearly.description: Number of yearly archives to retain. Set to 0 to disable.

exclude_patterns.description: List of glob patterns (rsync-style) to exclude from backups.

backup_paths.description: List of filesystem paths to include in backups.

features.description: Feature flags for advanced filesystem support.

statx.description: Use statx() for faster inode tracking (requires Linux ≥4.11).

repository_migration.description: Enable automatic repository migration. Should be disabled unless instructed by docs.
